meta.task_text: Design a battery for power tools: nominal capacity >= 2 Ah, support 5C discharge (capacity retention >= 95%), support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60C, power density >= 4000 W/kg.

threshold_parsing_notes.capacity_ah: nominal capacity judged on 1C DFN discharge capacity_ah; 60C judged in BOTH operating scenarios of the task: 4C fast charge at 45C (T_max_K, canonical Stage-4 exam) and 5C discharge at 25C (t_max_5c_k, mechanically copied from 5C output T_max_K into a derived metrics file)
threshold_parsing_notes.capacity_retention_5c: mechanically computed 5C capacity / same-params 1C capacity per SKILL Stage 3 rate-scenario rule, written to a derived metrics file for log-evaluate

meta.base_rationale: task text names no electrode system -> deterministic default Chen2020 per SKILL 1.5 anchor table; anchor verified by parameter dump: NMC811/graphite OCP set, Nominal cell capacity 5 Ah, SEI kinetics present, no native plating parameters (runtime-injected with trace), geometry/thermal keys native (Electrode height 0.065 m x width 1.58 m).
meta.test_fixture: Chen2020 initial-SOC artifact (cathode 27% lithiated, SKILL-documented: 'initial state is discharged') normalized to a standard fully-charged characterization state for ALL protocols; Initial concentration in positive electrode [mol.m-3] = 63104 (its maximum), Initial concentration in negative electrode [mol.m-3] = 33133 (its maximum). Constant across every candidate in this case (never varied between candidates) - test-condition normalization, NOT a design lever.
meta.ablation_set_by: defaults (task text names no ablation switches)

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (task text does not lock the system; widest interpretation)

meta.freedoms_basis: zero-interaction rule: degrees of freedom not declared in the task text take the widest interpretation with an audit record (t1_r1 lesson)
meta.excluded_levers: solid-phase conductivity/diffusivity, initial concentration/lithiation variations (used only as the fixed test fixture above), initial SEI thickness, charge cut-off voltage
